sentences.japanese: 刈られた草の匂いは暑い夏の午後のイメージを想い浮かばせる。
sentences.english: The smell of cut grass summons up images of hot summer afternoons.

sentences.japanese: リックとキャロルは二ヶ月前に別れたが、リックの方はいまだに彼女を想い続けている。
sentences.english: Rick and Carol broke up two months ago, but he's still carrying a torch for her.

sentences.japanese: だれしも、楽しい青春を平穏無事な時期として想い起こす。
sentences.english: Everyone remembers the happy days of his youth as his halcyon days.

sentences.japanese: あの人の顔の一部が私の昔の男友達を想い起こさせた。
sentences.english: Something in his face really reminded me of an old boyfriend of mine.

sentences.japanese: 彼女の話は私の両親の想い出を呼び戻してくれる。
sentences.english: Her story brings back memories of my parents.
